name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 5
source:
In the year 2020, the protagonist and her childhood friends prepare for their Christmas break. As they board an airplane to return to Japan, they are sucked into the parallel world. This world is experiencing the turbulent end of the Tokugawa shogunate in December 1863. Using a magical hourglass, she gains the unsteady power to travel to both worlds. Although she and her companions flicker in and out of the parallel world, her adventures within this world span a total of three years.

Initially, the protagonist desires to save the suffering Four Gods from the parallel world's warring factions in order to save her mysteriously ravaged home world. As time passes, she learns that both worlds are being merged to create another world. Hoping to prevent the forceful deaths of two worlds, she willingly sacrifices fragments of her own life force to protect those dear to her.

[from [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_5]Koei Wikia[/url]]
translation:
2020年，主人公与青梅竹马们正准备迎接圣诞假期。他们登上返回日本的飞机时，却被吸入平行世界。那个世界正处于1863年12月动荡的幕末时期。借助一只魔法沙漏，主人公获得了往返两个世界的不稳定力量。尽管她和伙伴在平行世界中时隐时现，自己在其中的冒险总共跨越了三年。

起初，主人公希望从平行世界交战势力手中救出受苦的四神，以拯救遭到神秘蹂躏的故乡世界。随着时间推移，她得知两个世界正被融合，以创造另一个世界。为了阻止两个世界被强行毁灭，她甘愿牺牲自身生命力的碎片，守护珍视之人。

[摘自[url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_5]光荣维基[/url]]
